title: Thunder's leadership book (coordinated by Cris Pop), The Foundation: leadership is built, not born
summary: The chapter argues leadership is built through self-reflection, purpose, daily action and small acts of care, not inherited or mystical. It reports Cris's formula Confidence = Certainty + Faith, his habit of living one idea deeply, and Thunder's commitment to build, fail, learn and rebuild without waiting for permission.

principles.text: Leadership is built, not born, so it is available to anyone willing to do the work.
principles.quote: If leadership is built, not born, then it’s available to anyone willing to do the work.

principles.text: Start with purpose: why you lead, personally. Leadership without purpose is performance that burns you out.
principles.quote: Leadership without purpose is not quite leadership. It’s more like performance.

principles.text: Self-trust formula Cris shared: confidence is certainty from past wins plus faith in future potential.
Commit to build, fail, learn and rebuild without waiting for permission, perfect conditions or complete information.
principles.quote: We’re going to build, fail, learn, and rebuild until we create something that changes lives.

principles.text: Go deep on one idea rather than consuming more; live it, act daily, and teach it to someone else.
principles.quote: Wisdom only becomes transformation when you live it, not when you collect it.

principles.text: Culture comes from people leading by example, not rules or posters; notice and amplify those quietly leading without a title.
principles.quote: The right culture doesn’t come from rules or posters on the wall. It comes from people who lead by example, and that starts with you.
